newsitem.title: FRANCE: BoF's Trichet - investment needed, time is right.
newsitem.headline: BoF's Trichet - investment needed, time is right.

text.p: Bank of France head Jean-Claude Trichet said on Tuesday investment was the main weak point in the French economy and that he believed the time was right now for firms more widely to start investing.

"We believe investment is the missing piece needed to make French economic growth more robust. Conditions are right in our opinion for investment to take off under good auspices," Trichet said in reply to a question at a news conference on the central bank's 1996 annual report.
Among those conditions were high competitivity, low interest rates and good corporate cashflow levels, he said.
"Big companies are clearly starting to invest more...which is not necessarily the case for small and medium sized companies globally," he said.
